text:
[LTAC.6.2.1] An `after` body may contain any action legal in a
rule's RHS ([LGRA.10.1]). The action list executes when the
follow-up rule fires; the actions' own semantics are unchanged.

idris.name: ltac_3_1__body_runs_timed
idris.note: 'The action list executes when the follow-up rule fires': the `Delayed` minted at the follow-up's firing and not before. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_3_3__rules
idris.note: A body with an `emit`: the action a rule's RHS may hold, run when the follow-up fires. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__follow_up
idris.note: The body's actions run as the follow-up's RHS, their semantics the engine's own. LESS than the clause: a body of `emit` and `log`, the fragment's actions. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_5__capture_snapshot
idris.note: 'The actions' own semantics are unchanged': a body's expression evaluates over the timer as it would have over the parent's match.
